channel.title: Code Reviews | Marco Troisi
channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: Why unnecessary variables are bad for your code
item.description: Variables shouldn't be used as a shortcut toward readability. Only good code design can give you that.

item.title: Basic abstraction techniques: What code reviewers need to know
item.description: As a code reviewer, keeping code readable and maintainable is job one. Learn how to spot overly complex code—and simplify it.

item.title: Useless comments can ruin your code reviews. Here's how to erase them
item.description: Comments can point to inherent problems with code you're reviewing, but many are a waste. Here's how to separate the good from the bad.

item.title: How to run code reviews in your dev team's workflow
item.description: What's the best time to do code reviews? When considering your development or DevOps workflow.

item.title: The Ethics of Code Reviews
item.description: Code Reviews are a powerful tool not only to improve the quality of our code, but also to make our teammates' life easier. Be a constructive Code Reviewer.
